subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for channel self-delivered send reporting?
rationale: The PR adds release-facing Plugin SDK API surface whose naming, idempotency semantics, and hook behavior become external plugin contract once shipped.

options.title: Accept seam after proof
options.body: Require the API-baseline fix plus redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof, then land the generic delivery-report contract as the supported path.

options.title: Pause for API redesign
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while maintainers settle a different public subpath or ownership shape before this releases.

recommendation.title: Accept seam after proof
